Class ArithmeticOperators

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation.ArithmeticOperators
public class ArithmeticOperators extends Object
算术聚合操作的网关，可对数字执行数学运算。
Since:
1.10
Author:
